data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of $8.4m (2014: favourable run off deviation of $169.1m) was experienced during the year in respect of various lines of business. Most significantly releases within aviation ($7.2m), marine ($5.4m), liability ($10.7m) where offset by increases in reinsurance ($20.2m). This is mainly due to a reduction in the ultimate loss estimates.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims development (per the published gross claims development triangle) shows a net adverse prior-year development of approximately $124.5m (3.12% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven by increases in the estimates on older underwriting years (notably 2011 and 2012). However, the managing agent's movement note reports a net prior accident year release of $8.4m after reinsurance effects, with releases noted in Aviation, Marine and Liability offset by increases in reinsurance. The reported difference reflects that the narrative figure is a net (after reinsurance) amount while the triangle-based calculation above is gross.

data.data_quality_notes: There is a divergence between the managing agent's narrative (which reports a net prior year release of $8.4m) and the gross claims development triangle (which implies a gross adverse prior-year development of $124.485m). The narrative amounts appear to be net of reinsurance; the triangle values are gross. The syndicate also reports a significant RITC into 2014 (2013 and prior years reinsured to close into 2014 for an RITC premium of $2,043m) which inflates the '2010 & prior' column and can distort simple aggregate comparisons. Prior-year development figure provided here was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (page 38) because the movement note narrative only gave a net (after reinsurance) figure. Users should treat the gross PYD (triangle-based) and the reported net release as representing different measures (gross vs net).
